name: Korean peninsula
summary: North Korea fires about 10 ballistic missiles amid DMZ landmine row
state: North Korea fired about ten short-range ballistic missiles from near Wonsan on 29 Oct, its 17th launch of 2026. A joint South Korea–UN probe found North Korea planted the mines that injured three South Korean soldiers in the DMZ on 21 Sep; Pyongyang denies it. No further launch was reported to 1 Nov.
for_you: Tension is elevated but there has been no direct clash between forces.
